title: Vertex
narrativeHeadline: Vertex takes the complexity out of tax for some of the world’s largest retailers. Its partner network, its products and its marketing were all growing at once.

stats.label: Customers and internal stakeholders we've interviewed

story.title: Growth on three fronts at the same time

children.text: A leading global provider of corporate tax software and services for some of the world’s largest retailers, Vertex aims to take the complexity out of sales and use tax, global taxation, and tax data for its customers. Vertex needed a partner to help them quickly and cohesively develop an evolving global customer experience. Their partner network was rapidly expanding, their products were maturing and their marketing needs were growing. They needed a team of nimble strategists, designers and technology experts that could manage and innovate across a complex digital marketing journey.

details.label: Strategy
details.body: An assessment of Vertex’s market, data and customer journey came first.

details.label: Design
details.body: A personalized, multi-visit B2B experience, built to scale and nurture prospects across an organization.

details.label: Technology
details.body: A globalized site carrying regional content, with several points of entry — a partner channel and automated chat among them.

media.alt: Vertex logo over graphical arrow patterns.

story.title: One global experience, many points of entry

children.text: Starting with an assessment of Vertex’s market, data and customer journey, we created a personalized, multi-visit B2B experience designed to scale and nurture prospects across an organization. The globalized site allows for regional-centric content and solution offerings and considers various points of entry including a partner channel and automated chat. Ongoing, through rigorous, data-driven processes, we are able to quickly adapt and create a connected global customer experience for Vertex.
